questions.q_en: Following a certain logic, if ‘36’ is related to ‘9’ and ‘100’ is related to ‘49’, to which of the following is ‘225’ related?

questions.solution_en:
{ – 3}² = 2nd no.
{ – 3}² = {6 – 3}² = 3² = 9
{ – 3}² = {15 – 3}² = 12² = 144
